captions.instagram:
Concept. Not a client project. Quillwood Landscapes is a fictional business.

A landscaper sells with photos of gardens. This homepage opens with a stock photo of a handshake, and the project gallery is 48 full-size photos that keep spinning on a phone. The phone number is on the Contact page.

So we led with three recent jobs, sized to load quickly, made the quote form ask for a photo of your yard instead of an essay, and kept a call button on screen.

Is your best work the first thing people see? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept. Not a client project. A fictional landscaper’s homepage, redesigned for the phone.

The work is the whole pitch for a landscaper, and this homepage hides it. The top of the page is a stock photo of two people shaking hands. Below it, a gallery of 48 full-size photos keeps loading on a phone connection. There is no call button.

The new version opens with three recent jobs, sized for a phone so they show straight away. The quote form asks for the suburb, the job and a photo of the yard. A call button stays on screen as you scroll.

If your site makes people wait to see your work, I’m happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
